# Data contracts of the world-development pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). The pack's guide, [config/packs/world-development/guides/world-development.md](../../../config/packs/world-development/guides/world-development.md), shows the same contracts (generated from the same files, tools/packgen/common/guide_data.py) next to how to use the pack and where each kind's data comes from (*Data retrieval*).

| Command | Kind | Class | Status | Fields | To review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [WDI](#wdi-development-profile-development-profile) | `development-profile` | fundamental | active | 22 | 0 |
| [WDIS](#wdis-development-indicator-series-development-series) | `development-series` | fundamental | active | 16 | 0 |

## WDI: Development profile (`development-profile`)

One country's World Development Indicators: the latest of each, the world map shaded by GDP per head, each series one click away.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [development-profile.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/world-development/contracts/development-profile.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: World Bank, World Development Indicators, pulled by the world-development feed (config/feeds/world-development.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per development profile, keyed by PROFILE_ID. |
| Key | `PROFILE_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^WDI-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the world-development feed's schedule (30 6 * * * UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Storage | connector `development-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/development/development-profile/` |
| Test data | config/packs/world-development/samples |
| Worked example | [world-development/development-profile](../samples/world-development/development-profile.md) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PROFILE_ID` | id | required |  | WDI- and the country's ISO 3166 alpha-3 code. | `WDI-AUS` (pattern `^WDI-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. | `Australia` |  |
| `ISO3` | text | required |  | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, the key the map shades by. | `AUS` |  |
| `ISO2` | text | required |  | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (the World Bank's own id). | `AU` |  |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional |  | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. | `Australia` |  |
| `REGION` | id | required |  | The World Bank region the economy belongs to (East Asia & Pacific, Sub-Saharan Africa ...). | `East Asia & Pacific` | `region` |
| `INCOME_GROUP` | id | required |  | The World Bank income group by GNI per head (Low, Lower middle, Upper middle, High income). | `High income` | `country-group` |
| `CAPITAL` | text | optional |  | The capital city as the World Bank lists it. | `Canberra` |  |
| `POPULATION` | amount | optional | persons | Total population, mid-year (SP.POP.TOTL), the latest year with a value. | `27614411.0` |  |
| `GDP_PER_CAPITA` | amount | optional | USD | GDP divided by mid-year population, current US dollars (NY.GDP.PCAP.CD), the latest year. | `65129.7227990563` |  |
| `GDP_GROWTH` | rate | optional | % a year | Annual growth of GDP at constant prices (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG), the latest year. | `1.35039785076631` |  |
| `INFLATION` | rate | optional | % a year | Consumer price inflation (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG), the latest year. | `2.87403791660173` |  |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | amount | optional | % of labour force | Unemployed share of the labour force, ILO modelled estimate (SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS), the latest year. | `4.09` |  |
| `LIFE_EXPECTANCY` | amount | optional | years | Life expectancy at birth (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), the latest year. | `83.0512195121951` |  |
| `POVERTY_HEADCOUNT` | amount | optional | % of population | Share living below the World Bank's international poverty line (SI.POV.DDAY), the latest survey year. | `0.9` |  |
| `ELECTRICITY_ACCESS` | amount | optional | % of population | Share of the population with access to electricity (EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS), the latest year. | `100.0` |  |
| `INTERNET_USERS` | amount | optional | % of population | Share of the population using the internet (IT.NET.USER.ZS), the latest year. | `96.13140106` |  |
| `CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT_DEBT` | amount | optional | % of GDP | Central government debt, total (GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS), the latest year; empty for most economies that do not report it. | `57.8834285733848` |  |
| `INDICATORS` | record list | required |  | Every indicator the feed pulled for the economy, one row each: INDICATOR, UNIT, LATEST, YEAR, CODE and WDI_SERIES. |  | `macro-indicator` |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |
| `DATA_YEAR` | text | optional |  | The most recent year any indicator of the economy has a value for. | `2025` |  |
| `INDICATOR_COUNT` | integer | required |  | How many indicators have at least one value for the economy. | `10` |  |

**Nested `INDICATORS[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INDICATOR` | text | required |  | The indicator's name as the World Bank publishes it. | `Population, total` |  |
| `UNIT` | text | required |  | What the value measures (the feed's YAML names it). | `persons` |  |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | the row's UNIT | The latest published value, in the unit shown. | `27614411.0` |  |
| `YEAR` | text | required |  | The calendar year of the latest value. | `2025` |  |
| `CODE` | text | required |  | The indicator's code in the World Bank API (SP.POP.TOTL). | `SP.POP.TOTL` |  |
| `WDI_SERIES` | id | required |  | The development-series page with the history (WDIS-<ISO3>-<code>). | `WDIS-AUS-SP_POP_TOTL` (pattern `^WDIS-`) | `development-series` |

**Nested `PROVENANCE`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | `World Bank, World Development Indicators` |  |
| `DATASET` | text | required |  | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | `World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)` |  |
| `RETRIEVED_AT` | date | required |  | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | `2026-11-06` |  |
| `LICENCE` | text | required |  | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | `CC BY 4.0` |  |
| `ATTRIBUTION` | text | required |  | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | `The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0).` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The source's page for this record. | `https://data.worldbank.org/country/AU` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | `False` |  |

**Links:** `REGION` → `region`, `INCOME_GROUP` → `country-group`, `INDICATORS` → `macro-indicator`, `INDICATORS[].WDI_SERIES` → `development-series`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `PROFILE_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `ISO2`, `REGION`, `INCOME_GROUP`, `INDICATORS`, `PROVENANCE`, `INDICATOR_COUNT`
- unique: key `PROFILE_ID`; per snapshot
- pattern: field PROFILE_ID; pattern ^WDI-
- link: field REGION; kind region
- link: field INCOME_GROUP; kind country-group
- link: field INDICATORS; kind macro-indicator
- range: field INDICATOR_COUNT; min 0
- link: field INDICATORS[].WDI_SERIES; kind development-series

**Notes**

- Stored in the worldlake lake (config/lakes/worldlake.yaml), table <data>/delta/worldlake/development/development-profile/, one JSONL.gz a business date loaded with mode replace (a rerun of a day is idempotent).
- Delivered as JSON Lines: one document a line, UTF-8, gzipped, with a .ready file naming the lake, pack, kind, connector, business date, mode, key, sha256 and row count (DATA_LAKE_GUIDE.md section 4).

## WDIS: Development indicator series (`development-series`)

One World Development Indicator of one country by year: the history, the latest value and the change.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [development-series.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/world-development/contracts/development-series.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: World Bank, World Development Indicators, pulled by the world-development feed (config/feeds/world-development.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per development indicator series, keyed by SERIES_ID. |
| Key | `SERIES_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^WDIS-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the world-development feed's schedule (30 6 * * * UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Storage | connector `development-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/development/development-series/` |
| Test data | config/packs/world-development/samples |
| Worked example | [world-development/development-series](../samples/world-development/development-series.md) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required |  | WDIS-, the country's ISO alpha-3 code and the indicator's code with its dots as underscores. | `WDIS-CAN-EG_ELC_ACCS_ZS` (pattern `^WDIS-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The country and the indicator, as one name. | `Canada · Access to electricity (% of population)` |  |
| `WDI_PROFILE` | id | optional |  | The country's development-profile page (WDI-<ISO3>); empty for a World Bank aggregate (the world, a region, an income group), which has series but no profile. | `WDI-CAN` (pattern `^WDI-`) | `development-profile` |
| `ISO3` | text | required |  | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, or the World Bank aggregate's code (WLD the world, EAS ... SSF the regions, HIC ... LIC the income groups). | `CAN` |  |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional |  | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. | `Canada` |  |
| `INDICATOR_CODE` | text | required |  | The indicator's code in the World Bank API. | `EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS` |  |
| `INDICATOR` | text | required |  | The indicator's name as the World Bank publishes it. | `Access to electricity (% of population)` |  |
| `UNIT` | text | required |  | What the value measures (the feed's YAML names it). | `% of population` |  |
| `DEFINITION` | text | optional |  | The World Bank's source note for the indicator, cut at 600 characters. | `Access to electricity is the percentage of population with …` |  |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The latest published value, in the unit shown. | `100.0` |  |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | text | required |  | The calendar year of the latest value. | `2024` |  |
| `PREVIOUS` | amount | optional | the record's UNIT | The value of the year before the latest one with a value; empty for a one-year series. | `100.0` |  |
| `PREVIOUS_YEAR` | text | optional |  | The year of the previous value. | `2023` |  |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | the record's UNIT | The latest value less the previous one, in the unit shown. | `0.0` |  |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required |  | The value by year, oldest first, over the feed's window (YEAR, VALUE). |  |  |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |

| `YEAR` | text | required |  | The calendar year of the value. | `2019` |  |
| `VALUE` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The published value for that year, in the unit shown. | `100.0` |  |

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |

| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | `World Bank, World Development Indicators` |  |

| `RETRIEVED_AT` | date | required |  | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | `2026-11-06` |  |
| `LICENCE` | text | required |  | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | `CC BY 4.0` |  |
| `ATTRIBUTION` | text | required |  | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | `The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0).` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The source's page for this record. | `https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS?locatio…` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | `False` |  |

**Links:** `WDI_PROFILE` → `development-profile`.

**Validation**

- Delivered as JSON Lines: one document a line, UTF-8, gzipped, with a .ready file naming the lake, pack, kind, connector, business date, mode, key, sha256 and row count (DATA_LAKE_GUIDE.md section 4).
